about: How each Short looks and sounds. plan.py gives every new Short one option per dimension: mostly the options that are keeping viewers watching (analytics/looks.json), sometimes the others, so the channel keeps learning and never looks templated. The weekly review adds new options and retires weak ones (set "retired": "<why>" rather than deleting, so old results still read).

punch.desc: bold capitals, white with a dark outline, the spoken word turns amber, 3 words at a time, lower middle

clean.desc: sentence case on a dark rounded panel, the spoken word in the accent colour, up to 4 words, lower third

pop.desc: one or two huge words at a time near the centre, the spoken word in the accent colour and slightly bigger

boxed.desc: bold capitals, the spoken word sits on an accent-coloured box, 3 words at a time

steady.desc: gentle zooms and pans, punch-ins only on impact beats

punchy.desc: bigger zooms, a punch-in at every new beat and harder hits

grade.about: Colour grade on photos and footage (graphics and captions are not affected)

cinematic.desc: a little warmer and less saturated, darker edges
